# Changelog writer

Load this skill when a pull request is about to merge and `CHANGELOG.md` needs its line. Do not load it for the
release notes of a tagged version, or for a commit message (CORE-SKILL-03).

## Steps

1. Run `git log --oneline main..HEAD` and read the branch's commits (CORE-WORK-01). Check: you can say what a user
   of the project notices.
2. Pick the section: Added for new behaviour, Changed for changed behaviour, Fixed for bug fixes (CORE-SKILL-05).
   Check: the change belongs in exactly one section.
3. Open `CHANGELOG.md` and add one line under `## Unreleased`, in that section, in the past tense, naming what a
   user notices rather than how the code changed. Check: one new line, and no other line changed.
4. End the line with the pull request number, like `(#123)`. Check: the number is the pull request's own.

## Example

Good, under Fixed: `- Exported reports keep their column order (#123).`

Bad, under Added: `- Refactored the export helper.`, which says how the code changed and has no number
(CORE-SKILL-10).
